## Outcome

Describe the developer or maintainer problem this pull request solves. Link the
issue with `Closes #<number>` when applicable.

## Approach

Summarize the implementation and important tradeoffs. Link the relevant task,
issue, or ADR when one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Documentation is updated when commands or behavior changed.
- [ ] User-visible changes include appropriate screenshots or recordings.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or fabricated product claims are included.

List any additional manual or automated verification below:

```text
Commands, environments, and results
```

## Visual changes

For user-visible changes, include before/after screenshots or a short recording.
Write `Not applicable` when the change has no visual effect.

## Scope check

- [ ] This change implements documented behavior or clearly labels planned behavior.
- [ ] Breaking architectural decisions include an ADR or explicit maintainer discussion.
- [ ] The change is focused enough to review, test, and revert independently.
